metadata.notes: Minimal tool entity, added so data/actions/beat.json's requiredTools reference resolves — same minimal-tool precedent as knife.json/mixer.json. Deliberately distinct from 'mixer': beating eggs with a fork/whisk in a bowl is a different, lower-tech operation than blending in mixer.json's electric mixer, and — unlike MIX — is naturally controllable by degree (a few strokes vs. thoroughly whipped), which is what data/actions/beat.json's 'intensity' parameter captures.
